description:
The Poompuhar State Award is a prestigious recognition scheme initiated by the Government of Tamil Nadu. 

It was launched in the year 1971. 

The primary objective of the Poompuhar State Award is to promote and encourage artisans and craftsmen in the field of handicrafts and handlooms. 

This award aims to recognize the exceptional skills and contributions of artisans who work in traditional crafts. 

The award also seeks to preserve the rich cultural heritage of Tamil Nadu. 

The Poompuhar State Award is conferred annually. 

It is presented during the Tamil Nadu Handicrafts and Handlooms Exhibition. 

The award includes a cash prize and a certificate of recognition. 

The cash prize for the award is set at ₹10,000. 

In addition to the cash prize, the awardees receive a citation that highlights their contributions. 

The award is open to artisans and craftsmen who are residents of Tamil Nadu. 

Eligibility criteria require applicants to be engaged in traditional handicrafts or handloom weaving. 

There are no specific age limits for applicants. 

However, applicants must demonstrate proficiency in their craft. 

The application process for the Poompuhar State Award involves several steps. 

Interested artisans must submit an application form. 

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the Tamil Nadu Handicrafts Development Corporation. 

Applicants must provide details about their craft and the materials used. 

They are also required to submit photographs of their work. 

In addition to the application form, artisans must provide proof of residency in Tamil Nadu. 

This can be in the form of a government-issued ID or utility bill. 

The application must be submitted to the Tamil Nadu Handicrafts Development Corporation. 

The deadline for submission is typically set for the end of June each year. 

After the deadline, applications are reviewed by a selection committee. 

This committee consists of experts in the field of handicrafts and handlooms. 

The selection process is based on the quality and uniqueness of the craft. 

Awardees are announced in August each year. 

The awards ceremony is held in September during the annual exhibition. 

The Poompuhar State Award not only recognizes individual artisans but also promotes the handicraft industry in Tamil Nadu. 

It serves as a platform for artisans to showcase their work to a broader audience. 

The award helps in enhancing the visibility of traditional crafts. 

It encourages artisans to innovate and improve their skills. 

The Poompuhar State Award has contributed significantly to the preservation of traditional crafts in Tamil Nadu. 

It has also fostered a sense of pride among artisans. 

Over the years, many artisans have benefited from the recognition provided by this award. 

The award has also led to increased sales and demand for their products. 

The Tamil Nadu Handicrafts Development Corporation plays a crucial role in implementing the award scheme. 

This corporation is responsible for promoting and developing handicrafts in the state. 

They also provide training and support to artisans. 

The Poompuhar State Award is part of a broader initiative by the Tamil Nadu government to support the handicraft sector. 

This initiative includes various schemes aimed at improving the livelihoods of artisans. 

The award has seen participation from a diverse range of crafts. 

These include pottery weaving woodwork and metal crafts. 

The recognition has also encouraged younger generations to take up traditional crafts. 

The impact of the Poompuhar State Award extends beyond individual artisans. 

It contributes to the overall economic development of rural areas in Tamil Nadu. 

The award has helped in creating job opportunities in the handicraft sector. 

It has also played a role in promoting tourism by attracting visitors interested in traditional crafts. 

The Poompuhar State Award is an essential part of Tamil Nadu's cultural identity. 

It reflects the state's commitment to preserving its rich artisan heritage. 

The award continues to inspire artisans to excel in their crafts. 

It serves as a reminder of the importance of traditional skills in a rapidly changing world. 

The Poompuhar State Award is a testament to the enduring legacy of Tamil Nadu's artisans. 

It highlights the need for continued support and recognition of traditional crafts. 

The award has become a symbol of excellence in the handicraft industry. 

It encourages artisans to strive for quality and innovation in their work. 

The Poompuhar State Award is a significant initiative that showcases the talent and creativity of Tamil Nadu's artisans. 

It plays a vital role in sustaining the cultural heritage of the region. 

The recognition provided by the award helps artisans gain respect and appreciation for their work. 

It also fosters a sense of community among artisans. 

The award has a lasting impact on the lives of those who receive it. 

It empowers artisans to continue their craft with pride and dedication. 

The Poompuhar State Award is a valuable contribution to the welfare of artisans in Tamil Nadu. 

It stands as a beacon of hope for the preservation of traditional crafts in the state. 

This award continues to evolve and adapt to the changing needs of artisans. 

It remains a crucial element in the promotion of Tamil Nadu's rich cultural heritage. 

The Poompuhar State Award is a celebration of the skill creativity and resilience of Tamil Nadu's artisans.
